answers.rationale: C6 lists tool L1; adr.txt establishes L1 is LASER-A. M-17 holds LASER-1, satisfying LASER-A's cert requirement. tools.csv sets LASER-A hourly_fee at 12. C6 ran 15:00–16:00 (before 21:00), with 1 hour marked, so no after-hours multiplier applies: 12 × 1 = 12.

C7 uses LASER-A for M-17, who holds LASER-1. tools.csv sets LASER-A hourly_fee at 12. C7 ran 21:15–22:15 (after 21:00), so shop_rules.txt applies the 1.5× after-hours multiplier on 1 hour marked: 12 × 1.5 = 18.

Per shop_rules.txt, laser cutter use requires LASER-1 and CNC use requires CNC-1; checkout without required certification is unauthorized. C4 (M-19, LASER-A) is the only checkout where the member lacks the tool's required cert: M-19 has no certs and LASER-A requires LASER-1. All other checkouts either match required certs or use SAW-1, which has no cert_required.
C1 uses LASER-A for M-17, who holds LASER-1. tools.csv sets LASER-A hourly_fee at 12. C1 ran 18:00–20:00 (before 21:00), with 2 hours marked, so no after-hours multiplier applies: 12 × 2 = 24.

C5 has note PENDING, but shop_rules.txt only defines HOLD (tool parked in bay; not an extra billed day) and explicitly states it does not define other checkout notes. No source in the packet defines PENDING.
C2 is M-18 using CNC-1. members.csv, tools.csv, checkouts.csv, shop_rules.txt, and adr.txt contain no insurance rider or coverage information for any member or tool use.
